## Load pre-computed biomarker data

```{r load-precomputed}
# Niche DEGs (infected vs non-infected niches, all spots)
AllCategories_Clustermarkers_infectedvsnoninfected <- read.csv(
  paste0(BioMarkerDir, "AllCategories_Clustermarkers_MAST_infectedvsnoninfected.csv"))

# Spatial timepoint DEG lists (already filtered per timepoint vs D0)
Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList <- readRDS(
  paste0(BioMarkerDir, "Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList.rds"))

# Combined logFC table (spatial niches + timepoints + microarray)
FinalExpDEGsOriginal <- read.csv(
  paste0(BioMarkerDir, "FinalExpDEGsOriginal_Spatial_Microarry_Comp.csv"))

# Final conserved biomarkers (4-way intersection, already computed)
ConservedBiomarkers <- read.csv(
  paste0(BioMarkerDir, "ConservedMarkers/ConservedBiomarkers.csv"))
FinalOverallapping <- ConservedBiomarkers$x

cat("Pre-computed conserved biomarkers:", length(FinalOverallapping), "\n")
print(FinalOverallapping)
```

## Reconstruct the four gene sets for Venn / UpSet

```{r gene-sets}
# --- Set 1: Spatial IAN-derived DEGs ---
# Upregulated in infected niches, confirmed across timepoints
DEGsInfectedRegions_base <- AllCategories_Clustermarkers_infectedvsnoninfected %>%
  filter(cluster == "InfectedNiches" & p_val_adj <= 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1 & pct.1 > 0.25)

SpatialAcrossDpiDEGs <- unique(c(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList$PyeloD1_2$gene,
  Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList$PyeloD3_1$gene,
  Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList$PyeloD5_2$gene,
  Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList$PyeloD7_1$gene,
  Pyelonephritis_Infection_subDEGsList$PyeloD28_1$gene
))

SpatialIANdegs <- intersect(DEGsInfectedRegions_base$gene, SpatialAcrossDpiDEGs)
cat("Spatial IAN DEGs:", length(SpatialIANdegs), "\n")

# --- Set 2: Microarray DEGs (HeOuJ, D1/D3/D7 vs D0) ---
MicroSheetNames <- getSheetNames(
  paste0(MicroDir, "Microarray HeN and HeOuJ Kidney DEGs (all genes).xlsx"))
Microdata_list <- lapply(MicroSheetNames, function(s) {
  read.xlsx(paste0(MicroDir, "Microarray HeN and HeOuJ Kidney DEGs (all genes).xlsx"), sheet = s)
})
names(Microdata_list) <- MicroSheetNames

MouseMicroArrayDEGs <- unique(c(
  Microdata_list$`HeOuJ - Day 1 vs Day 0` %>% filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & logFC > 1 & AveExpr >= 6) %>% pull(mgi_symbol),
  Microdata_list$`HeOuJ - Day 3 vs Day 0` %>% filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & logFC > 1 & AveExpr >= 6) %>% pull(mgi_symbol),
  Microdata_list$`HeOuJ - Day 7 vs Day 0` %>% filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & logFC > 1 & AveExpr >= 6) %>% pull(mgi_symbol)
))
cat("Microarray DEGs:", length(MouseMicroArrayDEGs), "\n")

# --- Set 3: Mouse secreted proteins ---
SecretedMouseProteins   <- read.csv(paste0(SecretedDir, "Mouse.csv"))
SecretedMousefinalGenes <- unique(SecretedMouseProteins$Gene)
cat("Secreted proteins:", length(SecretedMousefinalGenes), "\n")

# --- Set 4: Urinary proteins (human → mouse homologs) ---
# Re-use the saved biomaRt mapping to avoid re-querying Ensembl
HumanUrinegene_mapping  <- read.csv(paste0(BioMarkerDir, "HumanUrinegene_mapping.csv"))
mh_data                 <- read.csv(paste0(MouseHumanDir, "HOM_MouseHuman_Symbol.csv"))
MouseHomo_HumanUrinegene <- mh_data %>%
  filter(Symbol.y %in% HumanUrinegene_mapping$hgnc_symbol) %>%
  pull(Symbol.x) %>%
  unique()
cat("Urinary proteins (mouse homologs):", length(MouseHomo_HumanUrinegene), "\n")

# Assemble the four-set list
CandiateDeggene_list <- list(
  `Spatial IAN DEGs`  = SpatialIANdegs,
  `Microarray DEGs`   = MouseMicroArrayDEGs,
  `Secreted proteins` = SecretedMousefinalGenes,
  `Urinary proteins`  = MouseHomo_HumanUrinegene
)
sapply(CandiateDeggene_list, length)

# Confirm 4-way intersection matches saved conserved list
FinalOverallapping_check <- Reduce(intersect, CandiateDeggene_list)
cat("4-way intersection:", length(FinalOverallapping_check), "\n")
print(FinalOverallapping_check)
```

## Figure 9B: Four-way Venn diagram

```{r fig9b-venn, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
Fig9B_Venn <- ggvenn(
  CandiateDeggene_list,
  fill_color      = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442"),
  stroke_size     = 0.5,
  set_name_size   = 3.2,
  show_percentage = FALSE,
  text_size       = 3
) +
  labs(title = "Multi-dataset overlap for candidate APN biomarker identification") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure9B_FourWay_Venn.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig9B_Venn,
  width = 6, height = 5
)
Fig9B_Venn
```

## Figure 9C: UpSet plot

```{r fig9c-upset, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
input_for_upset <- fromList(CandiateDeggene_list)

pdf(paste0(Outdir, "Figure9C_UpSet_CandidateBiomarkers.pdf"), height = 5, width = 9)
upset(
  input_for_upset,
  sets            = names(CandiateDeggene_list),
  set_size.show   = TRUE,
  order.by        = "freq",
  keep.order      = TRUE,

  sets.x.label    = "Set Size",
  point.size      = 3,
  line.size       = 1
)

  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size",
  sets.x.label    = "Set Size",
  point.size      = 3,
  line.size       = 1
)
```

## Figure 9D: Heatmap of candidate biomarkers across datasets

```{r fig9d-heatmap, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
group_levels <- c(
  "SpatialNiches",
  "SpatialDay1", "SpatialDay3", "SpatialDay5", "SpatialDay7", "SpatialDay28",
  "MicroArray_D1", "MicroArray_D3", "MicroArray_D7"
)

# Use the pre-computed combined FC table, filtered to conserved biomarkers
FinalExpDEGs_conserved <- FinalExpDEGsOriginal %>%
  filter(Gene %in% FinalOverallapping) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = ifelse(Padj <= 0.001, "***",
                   ifelse(Padj <= 0.01,  "**",
                   ifelse(Padj <= 0.05,  "*", ""))),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels)
  )

# Order genes by log2FC in spatial niches (high → low)
gene_order <- FinalExpDEGs_conserved %>%
  filter(Group == "SpatialNiches") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  pull(Gene)
# append any genes missing from SpatialNiches group
gene_order <- c(gene_order, setdiff(FinalOverallapping, gene_order))

FinalExpDEGs_conserved$Gene <- factor(FinalExpDEGs_conserved$Gene, levels = gene_order)

n_genes <- length(gene_order)

Fig9D_Heatmap <- ggplot(FinalExpDEGs_conserved,
                         aes(x = Group, y = Gene, fill = log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "log2FC"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), color = "black", size = 2.2, vjust = 0.5) +
#   # highlight the microarray cohort columns with a box
#   annotate("rect",
#            xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5,
#            ymin = 0.5, ymax = n_genes + 0.5,
#            fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Candidate APN biomarkers across datasets\n(box = microarray Cohort 1 validation)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure9D_CandidateBiomarker_Heatmap.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig9D_Heatmap,
  width    = 5,
  height   = max(4, n_genes * 0.28 + 1.5)
)
Fig9D_Heatmap
```

## Figure S10: Classical biomarker expression across 17 spatial niches

```{r load-spatial-object}
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- readRDS(
  file = paste0(SpatialIndir, "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Deconvoluted.RDS"))
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- UpdateSeuratObject(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "SCT"

# Set Annotation identity with ordered niche levels
niche_levels <- paste0("N", 1:17)
Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- factor(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation,
  levels = niche_levels[niche_levels %in% unique(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation)]
)
```

```{r fig-s10b-spatial-classical, fig.width=18, fig.height=3}
# Curated top representatives per category for spatial feature plots
top_classical_for_spatial <- c(
  "Nfkb1","Rela", "Irf7",
  "Il6", "Tnf", "Il1b",
  "Ccl2", "Ccl7", "Cxcl1",
  "Fn1", "Timp1",
  "Mmp9", "Dcn",
  "Cybb", "Col3a1",
  "S100a8","S100a9",
  "Arg1","Lcn2",
  "Gsdmd","Rnase6",
  "Icam1","Vcam1",
  "Padi4"
)
top_classical_present <- top_classical_for_spatial[
  top_classical_for_spatial %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)]

DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "RNA"

for (gene in top_classical_present) {
  tryCatch({

    #gene= "Lcn2"
    gene_max <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[gene, ]))
    gene_min <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[gene, ]))
    p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
      Pyelonephritis_Infection,
      features       = gene,
      images         = selectedslices,
      pt.size.factor = 1600,
      crop           = TRUE
    ) &
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = myPalette(4),
        limits  = c(gene_min, gene_max+1)
        #limits  = c(gene_min-0.5, gene_max)
      )
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(Outdir, "FigureS10B_Spatial_", gene, ".pdf"),
      plot     = p,
      height   = 3, width   = 15
    )
  }, error = function(e) message("Skipping ", gene, ": ", e$message))
}
```

## Figure S11: Identified biomarkers – spatial distribution and cellular source

```{r fig-s11d-spatial-conserved, fig.width=18, fig.height=3}
FinalOverallapping_present <- FinalOverallapping[
  FinalOverallapping %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)]
cat("Conserved biomarkers present in spatial object:", length(FinalOverallapping_present), "\n")

DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "SCT"

for (gene in FinalOverallapping_present) {
  tryCatch({
    gene_max <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[gene, ]))
    p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
      Pyelonephritis_Infection,
      features       = gene,
      images         = selectedslices,
      pt.size.factor = 1600,
      crop           = TRUE
    ) &
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = myPalette(4),
        limits  = c(0, max(gene_max, 1))
      )
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(Outdir, "FigureS11D_Spatial_", gene, ".pdf"),
      plot     = p,
      height   = 3, width   = 18
    )
  }, error = function(e) message("Skipping ", gene, ": ", e$message))
}
```
